title: deontic profile
description: A policy: the constraints an implementation evaluates together, the dictionaries they are written against at pinned versions, the parameters they take, and the groups they belong to. What a group means to the application (a release stage, a clause of a standard, a review cadence) is the application's business and lives in `extensions`; the language sees only names, membership and inclusion.

dictionaries.description: The dictionaries the sentences are written against, pinned. Names resolve across all of them.

strictness.description: Overrides the dictionaries' setting for this profile.

parameters.description: Declarations of the `<name>` parameters the sentences use. Values are bound at evaluation time; a declared default is used when no binding is given, and a parameter with neither skips the constraint with `unbound_parameter`.

unit.description: number only: the unit a quantity must carry to be compared (`percent`).

definitions.description: Term and reference sentences local to this profile, in the storage form.

groups.description: Named groups of constraints. `includes` forms a DAG: a group's members are its own plus those of every group it includes. Keyed by group name.

id.description: Stable within the profile across edits; what outcomes, verdicts and suppressions name.

refs.description: Where this comes from outside the language: a clause of a standard, a check id, a ticket. `scheme` says what kind of thing `id` names.

extensions.description: Application data the language ignores and preserves, keyed by the application's name so two applications never collide.
